description: This file contains shell script functions for managing Kubernetes version variables, including extracting version info from git, saving/loading version states, and generating ldflags for build processes.

methods.name: kube::version::get_version_vars
methods.description: Retrieves and sets version variables based on git state or provided version file.

methods.name: kube::version::save_version_vars
methods.description: Saves current version variables to a specified file.

methods.name: kube::version::load_version_vars
methods.description: Loads version variables from a specified file.

methods.name: kube::version::ldflags
methods.description: Generates ldflags string with version info for go build.
